Swans  are  large  water  birds  that  (620)  ________  to  the  family Anatidae,  which  also  includes  ducks  and  geese.  They  (621) __________  for  their  beauty  and  grace  and  are  often  used  as symbols of love, fidelity, and elegance. They are also famous for their  (622)  ________  features,  such  as  their  long  necks,  large wingspans,  and  striking  white  feathers.  (623)_______  ,  not  all swan  species  are  white;  the  black  Swan  (624)  __________  has black feathers  with  a  red  bill.  Swans  are  found  on  every continent and are known for their strong pair bonds. They mate for life and can live up to 20 years.
Q.620. (a) belonging    (b) belong    (c) belonged    (d) belongs
- Q.621.
- (a) are known
- (b) have knowing
- (c) had know
- (d) were known
